note: Names a batch is allowed to use (or to leave alone) even though tools/rename-glossary.json does not sanction them. Every entry needs an approver: the point of the file is that an exception is a decision, not a habit.

kinds.allowed-synonym: a word that means the same thing as a glossary canonical but is not in the glossary yet
kinds.allowed-numeric: a digit-bearing name that is meaningful rather than mechanical (sha256, alignTo16)
kinds.frozen-short-export: an exported binding whose name is one or two characters; the release ships it and renaming it would break consumers
kinds.allowed-budget: a file whose leftover-name count a human has decided may rise above its wave-start reading, with a reason; tools/verify_frontend_name_budget.mjs honours these and nothing else
